pages.title: Cole Protocol
pages.text: $(bold)Cole Protocol$(): the safe shutdown, about 3 minutes. It ramps down, cools, pulls the antimatter back into capsules in the dock, then drops the shield.$(br2)It needs empty capsule space in the dock, and holds until there is some.

pages.title: Safe To Dismantle
pages.text: When it finishes the Controller reads $(bold)SAFE TO DISMANTLE$(). Only then can you break parts without consequence.

pages.title: CLIP
pages.text: $(bold)CLIP$(): hold the button, or give the Controller a redstone signal. The matter stream is cut and output drops to zero at once.$(br2)The shield stays up and still needs power. Each CLIP loses about a tenth of a capsule.

pages.title: Restart
pages.text: Press Start after a CLIP to restart from injection, about 40 seconds.
